pinout.name: VAUX

pinout.name: VOUT
pinout.description: Adjustable synchronous boost output (1.8 V to 5.5 V; true load disconnect in shutdown).

pinout.name: L
pinout.description: Inductor switching node connected to integrated 150 mOhm main and 180 mOhm rectifying N-MOSFETs.

pinout.name: EN

pinout.name: UVLO
pinout.description: Programmable UVLO comparator input (250 mV falling / 350 mV rising); MUST connect to VAUX if unused.

pinout.name: PS
pinout.description: Power Save mode input (High = disabled / forced PWM, Low = enabled / PFM; do NOT float).

pinout.name: GND
pinout.description: Quiet control/logic analog ground reference for FB divider and control stage.

pinout.name: FB
pinout.description: Feedback input for adjustable TPS61200 external divider (VFB = 500 mV typ, 495-505 mV; fixed TPS61201/61202 tie to VOUT).

design_gotchas.title: Inverted PS Polarity (Fixed in Rev D) & Mandatory UVLO-to-VAUX / VAUX-Snubber Connections
design_gotchas.detail: Pin 8 (PS) is LOW = Power Save (PFM) Enabled and HIGH = Forced PWM (older datasheet revisions printed this backwards!), and neither PS nor EN may float. Pin 7 (UVLO) MUST tie to VAUX (Pin 1) when unused (otherwise VOUT stays disabled), and VAUX MUST have a low-ESR ceramic cap to GND (0.1 uF min; 1 uF if VOUT < 2.5 V) because it doubles as the main-switch snubber.

design_gotchas.title: Linear Down-Conversion Mode Dissipates Heavy Heat When VIN >= VOUT (Not a True Buck-Boost)
design_gotchas.detail: When VIN reaches or exceeds VOUT, TPS61200 drops excess voltage across its rectifying MOSFETs like a linear regulator (efficiency falls toward ~60% in Figs. 8-9 p.8), rapidly consuming its 971 mW dissipation budget at 85°C TA. Additionally, Power Save mode cannot be disabled while in Down Conversion mode.

design_gotchas.title: Deceptively Similar 3x3 mm VSON-10 (DRC) Package Is NOT Pin-Compatible With TPS63001DRCR
design_gotchas.detail: Although TPS61200DRCR and buck-boost TPS63001DRCR share the exact 3 mm x 3 mm VSON-10 (DRC) footprint, PGND PowerPAD, and Pins 5=VIN, 6=EN, 9=GND, 10=FB, Pins 1-4 and 7-8 are completely different (TPS61200: 1=VAUX, 2=VOUT, 3=L, 4=PGND, 7=UVLO, 8=PS vs TPS63001: 1=VOUT, 2=L2, 3=PGND, 4=L1, 7=PS/SYNC, 8=VINA).

design_gotchas.title: Average Input Current Limit (1350 mA Typ / 1200 mA Min) Restricts Ultra-Low-VIN Output Power
design_gotchas.detail: ILIM regulates average inductor/input current (not output current). At 0.5-0.9 V solar or single-cell inputs, deliverable 3.3 V load current drops sharply (~100-250 mA per Fig. 1 p.7), and cold startup into full load requires VIN >= 0.5 V before operating down to 0.3 V.

design_gotchas.title: Loop Stability Requires COUT >= 5 * L (uF/uH) and Soldered PGND PowerPAD
design_gotchas.detail: Section 11.2.2.4.2 Eq. 5 ties minimum ceramic output capacitance directly to inductance (COUT >= 5 * L(uH) uF, i.e., >= 11 uF for 2.2 uH; 2 x 10 uF recommended). Always solder the exposed thermal pad to PGND and Kelvin-route the 500 mV FB divider to quiet GND (Pin 9).

typical_use_cases: Single-cell solar, fuel-cell, or single/dual alkaline/NiMH battery boost (0.3-5.5 V) to adjustable 1.8-5.5 V
Single-cell Li-Ion boost/down-conversion to 3.3 V (300 mA+) or 5.0 V (up to 600 mA) with true load disconnect
Compact 3 mm x 3 mm VSON-10 energy-harvesting or portable medical supply with programmable UVLO
engineering_summary: The TPS61200DRCR is a 0.3 V to 5.5 V input (0.5 V full-load startup), adjustable 1.8 V to 5.5 V (VFB = 500 mV) synchronous boost converter in 3x3 mm VSON-10 (DRC) with a PGND PowerPAD (RthetaJA = 41.2°C/W, 971 mW max at 85°C TA). With a 1250-1650 kHz oscillator, 1350 mA typ (1200 mA min) average inductor current limit, 55 uA total Iq, true load disconnect, and ~93% peak boost efficiency, it adds linear Down Conversion when VIN >= VOUT. Decouple VAUX, tie unused UVLO to VAUX, verify PS polarity (Low=PFM, High=PWM), keep COUT >= 5*L uF/uH, and never confuse its DRC pinout with TPS63001DRCR; verify against the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 confirmed DRC 10-pin VSON Top View pinout (1=VAUX, 2=VOUT, 3=L, 4=PGND, 5=VIN, 6=EN, 7=UVLO, 8=PS, 9=GND, 10=FB) and Exposed Thermal Pad connected to PGND.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.5 verified Abs Max 7 V across all pins, Rec Op VIN 0.3-5.5 V, TA -40 to 85 C, TJ -40 to 125 C, RthetaJA 41.2 C/W, RthetaJC(top) 62.8 C/W, and RthetaJC(bot) 4.1 C/W.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.6 verified VOUT 1.8-5.5 V, VFB 500 mV (495-505 mV), oscillator 1250-1650 kHz, ILIM 1350 mA typ (1200-1500 mA), RDS(on) 150/180 mOhm, total IQ 55 uA (1+50+4 uA), and TSD 140 C.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1, p.7, p.8, and p.16 verified SLVS577E (Dec 2014) revision, 2.2 uH / 10 uF schematic, Eq. 5 COUT = 5*L(uF/uH), ~93% boost peak efficiency (Fig. 6), and linear down-mode efficiency drop (Figs. 8-9).
